name: console-06-people
prompt: Turn this into another tab of the same client screen in the console, edge to edge with no browser window. Keep exactly: the left sidebar, the client header (the orange rounded tile with a white m, "Munchly Foods", "munchly.smartclearance.com", the green "Live" pill) and the tab row, but now the "People" tab is selected and underlined instead of "Agents". Replace everything under the tabs: no agent list remains. Under the tabs: 1) Left two thirds: a search field "Search people" and a filter "Everyone ▾", then a white card with a table: columns "Person", "Role", "Signs in with", "Access", "Status". Rows, each with a small round portrait or initials: "Priya Deshmukh · Regional Supply-Chain Manager · Google · Approver · Active", "Anita Rao · Finance & GST · Google · Member · Active", "Vikram Sethi · Sustainability & BRSR · Google · Member · Active", "Arjun Nair · Workspace admin · Google · Admin · Active", "Rakesh bhai · Rakesh Traders · Phone and code · Partner · Active", "Ganesh ji · Shree Ganesh Kirana · Phone and code · Partner · Active", "Meera · Feeding India · Google, invited · Partner · Active", "Shree Sai Kirana · invited by Rakesh Traders · Phone and code · Partner · Invited" (grey pill), "India FoodBanking Network · invited by Munchly · Google, invited · Partner · Invited" (grey pill). Status "Active" as small green pills. 2) Right third: a white side panel "Invite a person" with fields "Name", "Work email or mobile number", a select "Access: Member", a select "Organisation: Munchly Foods", the grey note "Munchly staff need a munchly.in address; partners sign in with a code or by invitation.", and a dark green button "Send invitation". Crisp flat interface; all text legible.
postprocess: WebP; the PNG original stays local in .impeccable/mocks/
use: SC-25 design board: Munchly Foods, People tab: a table of nine people with role, sign-in method, access and status, including two invited partners, beside an 'Invite a person' panel with the sign-in rule.
